material.body: Audit (read-only): unit_rules.lua:68-79 calls six set_* natives per unit per tick; targeting.lua:129-141 re-picks targets and calls cmd_strike every tick; panels.lua:756-768 rebuilds all trees every 4 ticks before the diff; upgrades.lua:42-57 scans held items every tick; heroes.lua:224-234 runs attribute_bonuses every tick. Fix: change-gated setters, target re-pick on change or interval, dirty flags per panel. Witness: a per-tick cost measurement before and after; the 75-test suite must stay green. Re-audit (drain-f-1): setter gating already present (unit_rules.lua:72-102, heroes.lua:138-149); the item scan, panel rebuild and targeting re-pick have no host change signal, so the row is blocked_by perf-lua-per-tick-setters-blocker-drain-f-1. Current witness is 24 ok lines and 53 passed.
material.commit_comment: Lua per-tick target scan replaced by strike_reach native; 4.16 -> 2.70 ms per tick (-35%), hashes identical, published 3a09b208

notes.note: Gated: upgrades.lua on_tick via game.unit_item_gen (seen cache); panels.lua inventory tree via inventory_tree_cached (emit_all). Published 58f7c010d4287a3e2c094aed4d1e0acf5a4385d1, all CI check runs success. NOT gated, blocking facts: (1) targeting.lua on_tick 177-187 re-picks each tick through strike_choice (165-170 reads unit_position, range and best_in_reach); positions move every tick, so a target-set generation would freeze the pick and change strikes. (2) panels.lua hud_tree 225-237 reads hp, gold and clock (clock_text 214-222, game.time); skills_tree 452-460 reads remaining cooldowns; emit (136-146) dedups the output but the rebuild still runs. Gating those needs tick-varying inputs in the signal, an owner decision.
drain-controls-shard-2: scan lane left pending by default. Blocker unchanged: targeting re-pick (targeting.lua on_tick) cannot be change-gated without changing strike behaviour; no edit made.

survey-sim-8 evidence: scenarios/moba/targeting.lua:31 calls config.rule("aggro_priority") for every candidate of every unit in best_in_reach via target_class_order (line 144), so a string-keyed rule read runs units x candidates per tick; targeting.lua:178-187 sets cmd_strike for every living unit every tick; scenarios/moba/upgrades.lua:46-48 walks game.units() and reads unit_item_gen per unit per tick. Hoist the rule read to once per tick.
drain-ui-panels-9: left open; targeting.lua re-pick (177-187) cannot be change-gated without altering strike behaviour, no code route in my files.

drain-rust-10: no mod-host route with gain. cmd_strike (piccolo_host.rs:1430) only pushes Cmd::SetStrike; skipping unchanged would save a Vec push while the cost is the Lua strike_choice scan and per-unit native calls, which also move the applied counter. Gating targeting.lua on_tick is a pack change that alters strike behaviour; left open.
Owner decision (user): anything may change to remove this cost; pick the best choice (batched or skipped setters, see perf-setters lane).

Measured (local parity_hash, moba pack, one data snapshot, CPU seconds, same binary): before 4800 ticks 20.11 s = 4.16 ms per tick; after 13.10 s = 2.70 ms per tick (-35%). State hashes identical at 0, 1200 and 4800 ticks (4800: 321bdcd02a0cb622). Earlier ablations on an older snapshot: the targeting on_tick cost 1.37 ms per tick (doubling it), now about 0.49 ms; unit_rules on_tick about 1.04 ms per tick before its arithmetic rewrite, the rewrite saved about 0.5 ms. Shipped: game.strike_reach native (rust/crates/mod-host/src/piccolo_host.rs:1250) replaces the per-tick Lua grid and candidate scan (scenarios/moba/targeting.lua strike_choice:136); unit_rules.lua same formulas without math natives. Not done: per-unit cmd_strike skip (unsafe: arrays.rs resets strike_target on slot init). Remaining per-tick hooks not re-measured: upgrades.lua scan, heroes.lua attribute_bonuses, panels.lua rebuild every 4 ticks.
